response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT player_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM manager_award GROUP BY player_id), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM counts) SELECT c.player_id, c.cnt, CAST(c.cnt AS REAL) / t.total AS fraction FROM counts c CROSS JOIN total t WHERE t.total IS NOT NULL AND t.total <> 0 ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
